comments.author: @Itisallagame
comments.text: Poor people need to vilify rich people to justify themselves for being poor. Super sad situation. Rich or poor is literally just a mindset. All rich people, good or bad, choose to believe they were wealthy and they become what they believed. No other special ingredient. I learned this years ago and made myself a multibillionaire by pretending I was a billionaire at first. I told myself many times a day I am a billionaire and went window shopping at luxury stores. I even test drove a Lamborghini to feel what it was like to drive a hypercar. Every day before getting out of bed I visualized for 5 minutes what my life was like as a billionaire. Then before going to sleep as well. Opportunity started showing up that at first looked like nothing special. I just assumed some of them WILL lead to me becoming a billionaire. Within a few years I started 3 businesses where 2 failed and 1 was decently successful where I managed to save $1 million. I then came across Bitcoin early 2011 and invested $300k at just under $1. As Bitcoins price went up and down I refused to sell because selling would have meant I had to act on a fear, uncertainty or doubt. I would rather have $300k go to $0 than to act on any negative thought. I purchased some rental properties as well and some stocks like Tesla. I purchased some Ethereum and XRP when they just launched and never sold. It was obvious from 2008 that the old financial system was not going to last for much longer. Since then I have amassed over $29 billion and no rich list like Forbes even know I exist. I keep private and enjoy the anonymity. All the poor people now think the crypto boat has sailed and that it is not worth investing at these 'high' prices yet I am now telling myself daily I am a trillionaire. I KNOW XRP will be worth $50,000 in 20 years. I will then have many many trillions. I like to comment on videos like this because it always amazes me how poor people keep themselves poor with their minds. The rich are also not all bad people. The vast majority are decent, kind and generous people. They all know the mental power that made them wealthy so scheming daily how to screw the poor will just make them poor. The poor screw themselves already. We also can't really help the poor because if we give poor people things it actually keeps them poor because we strengthen the poor person's belief that others are needed for them to be helped. What poor people need is a mindset change and no amount of charity can change that. I have donated to organizations and fed millions of meals to poor people but non of that has changed the people's lives. I just lowered suffering for a brief moment till they get hungry again. I have helped people far more by simply talking to them than any donation has ever helped. We are a very exclusive club because of how we think and can't stand being around people with limiting beliefs. Once you mastered your mind it is like standing over a rotting corpse to be around someone with a poverty mindset. That is the single biggest reason why the ultra rich stick together. The most shocking thing to all of us ultra rich is how we can tell poor people that our mindset made us wealthy and 99.999999999% of them would not believe us. Absolutely blows our mind. Poor people really do want to be poor. It is a victim mentality that makes them feel comfortable with themselves by blaming everyone else for their situation. The thought that they might be responsible for their situation is horrifying to them. Their refusal to face that truth keeps them poor. Anyway, I hope the 0.0000000001% who read this feel empowered to master their mind and come join us ultra rich. Some fresh blood and ideas in this so called exclusive club will be greatly appreciated. God bless!
